title: PACA architecture
brief: A high level architecture image for the public README of PACA, the personal assistant of a one-person business: the agent, the custom MCP servers, the main database, the memory of the agent and the Telegram channel that exists today. Purple-dominant field with black depth and brown warmth; type system: a serif for the display, a humanist sans for the reading, a mono for the labels, near-white text, 1.55 leading, short measures.

artboards.title: Editorial river
artboards.tradeoff: Purple-dominant and editorial: a purple field, black support blocks, the brown of the human, and the flow of the business reads left to right

artboards.title: Blueprint
artboards.tradeoff: Purple blueprint on a black canvas, with the brown of the human and the protocol on every edge

artboards.title: Layered stack
artboards.tradeoff: The clearest reading of the whole system, layer by layer, in purple bands; less of a narrative, more of a map
